documentation.description: Describes registered cluster settings using the receiving node's setting registry. Reports definition metadata, not configured values. Unknown and filtered names are omitted. Results are paginated.

settings.description: Setting names to describe. Each entry is either an exact name (including a concrete affix key such as cluster.remote.alpha.seeds) or a prefix ending in .* such as cluster.routing.allocation.*, which expands to every setting registered under it. Concrete affix keys are not registered settings and are reachable only by exact name. Exact names and prefixes may be mixed.

size.description: Maximum number of settings per page, between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 100. Applies to the merged result, so a list of more than this many exact names is paged as well.

sort.description: Order of setting names within and across pages. A next_token is bound to the sort it was issued under and is rejected if replayed with the other one.

next_token.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response; continues the listing after the last key of that page. Omitted from the response on the last page.
